newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - LEKS Q1 NET PROFIT 2.8 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - LEKS Q1 NET PROFIT 2.8 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Leks Insurance made a net profit of 2.8 million kroons in the first quarter, it said on Friday.
Finance director Aarne Orav said the first quarter result was as expected if the 1997 profit estimate of nine million kroons was taken into account.
Leks assets were at 92.5 million kroons at the end of March.
Most of Leks shares are held by Tallinna Pank and the company is seeking a listing on the Tallinn bourse.
Leks had market share of 9.59 percent and was the third largest insurance company in the non-life insurance market.
The largest market share, or 17.78 percent, was held by Eesti Kindlustus subsidiary Eesti Varakindlustus, followed by ASA Insurance with 14.96 percent.
